title: A centered correlated Gaussian tail integral
statement:
Let $0<\rho<1$ and let $z_1,t\in\mathbb R$. For the density $g_\rho(z_1,z_2)$ of a pair of standard Gaussian variables with correlation $\rho$, defined as the standard Gaussian density at $z_1$ times the Gaussian density at $z_2$ with mean $\rho z_1$ and variance $1-\rho^2$, one has
\[\int_{z_2>t}(z_2-\rho z_1)g_\rho(z_1,z_2)\,dz_2=(1-\rho^2)g_\rho(z_1,t).\]
